## Summary

- Most common failure type: runtime visual closure that misses stateful control states and transactional lifecycle buckets.
- Most frequently affected agents: `Planner`, `PlanCritic`, `Executor`, `Pixel`, `Sentinel`, and `Orchestrator`.
- Highest-value improvement: require interactive-state and payment/booking bucket checks in the same proof matrix that already tracks route/device visual QA.
- MCP servers recommended: none. The failures were caught through simulator/manual QA and local tests; missing tool access was not the root cause.
- New agents recommended: none.

## 1. Rule Gaps

### RG-1: Resting screenshots did not catch inherited focused/active styling

Proof:

- `docs/LOG/SESSION_PLAN_OpenDesign_AmberDusk_Phases9_10_11_12_PhoneProfileSecondaryReadiness_2026-05-13.md:40-41` records that final visual parity requires runtime Flutter screenshots and that Open Design screenshots are design-reference proof only.
- `.TODO/VisualQA_OpenDesign_AmberDusk_TransactionalQARecovery_iOSSimulator_2026-05-13/SIMULATOR_SMOKE_REPORT.md:38-45` records teal/cyan runtime gaps in Booking Details, Chat, Create Offer, Dashboard CTAs, and Payment checkout after code/test gates had already passed.
- `docs/LOG/SESSION_PLAN_OpenDesign_AmberDusk_TransactionalQARecovery_2026-05-13.md:41-44` records the 2026-05-14 post-fix recheck of focused chat composer and create-offer amount fields.

Merged rules:

- `Planner.md`: UI plans must include focused, active, disabled, error, loading, and recovery-state checks for forms, composers, bottom sheets, payment/booking screens, and CTAs.
- `PlanCritic.md`: UI / Integration Gate now fails plans that omit those state checks.
- `Executor.md`: Visual Proof Gate now requires exercising those states in the current app.
- `Pixel.md`: UI implementation must inspect live focused/active states for inputs, composers, sheet handles, route backgrounds, and CTAs.
- `Sentinel.md`: manual QA scripts now require these runtime states.
- `Orchestrator.md`: Master Reports now require state-specific proof for the actual controls users touch.

### RG-2: Payment and booking fixes need source-route plus dashboard/list bucket proof

Proof:

- `.TODO/VisualQA_OpenDesign_AmberDusk_Phases9_10_11_12_iOSSimulator_2026-05-13/REPORT.md:77-89` records a processed QiCard payment returning to an unchanged `Book Basic` state while Dashboard Bookings remained empty.
- `.TODO/VisualQA_OpenDesign_AmberDusk_TransactionalQARecovery_iOSSimulator_2026-05-13/SIMULATOR_SMOKE_REPORT.md:47-61` records that QiCard processed success, return recovery, Dashboard Bookings after payment, and raw metadata suppression were not yet validated in that pass.
- `docs/LOG/SESSION_PLAN_OpenDesign_AmberDusk_TransactionalQARecovery_2026-05-13.md:38-47` records the remaining full-payment simulator gate, the later terminal-booking bucket recheck, and the still-open processed-payment branch.

Merged rules:

- `Planner.md`: payment/booking UI plans must include success, pending, failed, canceled, retry, recovery, and dashboard/list bucket verification.
- `PlanCritic.md`: payment/booking plans fail if dashboard/list bucket verification is omitted.
- `Executor.md`: payment/booking work must verify originating route, result route, Dashboard Bookings, Dashboard Work, and list buckets across lifecycle outcomes.
- `Sentinel.md`: QA now checks that payment/booking lifecycle paths land in the correct source-route and dashboard/list buckets.
- `Orchestrator.md`: Master Reports now require payment/booking bucket outcomes, including any external gateway branch not executed.

### RG-3: Customer-facing payment result UI needs an explicit no-technical-metadata rule

Proof:

- `.TODO/VisualQA_OpenDesign_AmberDusk_Phases9_10_11_12_iOSSimulator_2026-05-13/REPORT.md:93-105` records raw booking, payer, entity, correlation, and intent IDs shown on a customer-facing processed payment page.
- `docs/LOG/SESSION_PLAN_OpenDesign_AmberDusk_TransactionalQARecovery_2026-05-13.md:29-31` records the implementation direction: app-held payment intent state and sanitized customer-facing finish URLs.

Merged rules:

- `Planner.md`: payment/booking result plans must specify safe customer-facing summaries instead of raw technical fields.
- `PlanCritic.md`: plans fail if raw IDs or callback metadata can appear in primary UI.
- `Pixel.md`: payment/booking result surfaces must show status, amount, app context, next action, and recovery path while keeping technical IDs out of primary UI.
- `Sentinel.md`: QA now includes a customer-facing raw metadata check for payment/booking paths.

### RG-4: External payment branches must be marked unproven when the final action is not executed

Proof:

- `docs/LOG/SESSION_PLAN_OpenDesign_AmberDusk_TransactionalQARecovery_2026-05-13.md:22-25` records that payment submit/recovery screenshots remained pending because `Pay 50K IQD` required action-time confirmation.
- `.TODO/VisualQA_OpenDesign_AmberDusk_TransactionalQARecovery_iOSSimulator_2026-05-13/SIMULATOR_SMOKE_REPORT.md:47-61` lists the exact unvalidated QiCard success/recovery screenshots.
- `docs/LOG/SESSION_PLAN_OpenDesign_AmberDusk_TransactionalQARecovery_2026-05-13.md:47` records that processed-payment success callback verification remains a separate runtime branch.

Merged rules:

- `Executor.md`: if an external gateway submission, account creation, post publish, or similarly visible action cannot be executed, the exact branch and needed screenshots/commands must be recorded before closure.
- `Orchestrator.md`: Master Reports must say whether external payment actions were actually executed.

## 2. Rule Clarity Gaps

- Existing visual-proof rules already covered design-reference versus current-app runtime proof. This pass did not duplicate that baseline; it tightened the state matrix around controls users touch.
- Existing logging and observability rules already covered raw IDs and callback URLs in logs. This pass added the missing UI-facing payment-result restriction.
- Existing worker checkpoint and untrusted-patch rules already covered broad worker behavior. This pass did not add more delegation process text.

## 3. MCP Recommendations

None.

The observed gaps were not caused by missing live-access tooling. Computer Use, local command execution, Open Design MCP references, Flutter analyzer/tests, and screenshot artifacts were sufficient to find the issues.

## 4. Missing Skills

None.

The current skill set covers UI audit, polish, hardening, MVVM, docs, and simulator/manual QA. The missing piece was agent-rule specificity, not a new skill.

## 5. Agent Coordination Gaps

- `Planner -> Executor -> Sentinel`: all three now share the same stateful-control QA vocabulary.
- `Pixel -> Sentinel`: Pixel must hand off live interactive states, not only resting screenshots; Sentinel must verify them.
- `Executor -> Orchestrator`: external payment branches that are not executed remain open risk, and Orchestrator must preserve that fact in the Master Report.

## 6. Orchestrator Pipeline Improvements

- Master Reports now need state-specific proof for forms, composers, sheets, payment/booking screens, and transactional CTAs.
- Master Reports now need payment/booking lifecycle bucket outcomes after success, pending, failed, canceled, retry, and recovery paths.
- The pipeline must not convert green client tests or pre-submit screenshots into payment-flow completion when the gateway action was not executed.

## 7. New Agent Recommendations

None.

## 8. Things The Human Missed

- The final QiCard processed-payment branch is still a runtime branch, not a closed proof item, until the gateway Pay action is executed and the app recovery/dashboard screenshots are captured.
- The 2026-05-14 screenshots show post-fix coverage for several Amber Dusk transactional surfaces, but they do not replace an end-to-end processed payment run.
